notes: Assumption register: every number the engine relies on that is not a vendor price, tax rate or exchange rate (those are registered from prices.json, taxes.json and fx.json automatically). Confidence: verified = taken from an official or primary source; benchmark = from an official statistic or published reference used as a proxy; estimate = a reasoned judgement, to be replaced with your own figure or a measurement.

entries.label: Month length
entries.value: 30 days, 730 hours
entries.source: Calendar: 365 ÷ 12 ≈ 30 days; 8,760 hours ÷ 12 = 730

entries.label: Tokens per request or step (use-case defaults)
entries.value: Chat 1,500 in / 400 out; invoice step 2,500; ticket step 1,200; report step 6,000; …
entries.source: Typical prompt sizes; compared with sample texts in data/samples (see token measurements)

entries.label: Share of input served from cache
entries.value: 10–50% by use case
entries.source: Share of a prompt that repeats (system prompt, instructions, earlier steps), judged per use case

entries.label: Minimum prompt size for caching
entries.value: 512 to 4,096 tokens, by provider and model
entries.source: Each provider's caching documentation, stored per model in data/prices.json (cache_min_tokens)

entries.label: Busiest-hour share of daily traffic
entries.value: 15% (8% for batch agents)
entries.source: Typical daytime traffic peak for business chat

entries.label: GPU capacity headroom
entries.source: Capacity-planning margin so peak traffic does not saturate GPUs

entries.label: Extra GPU capacity for real-time voice
entries.source: Margin for low-latency streaming

entries.label: Open-model memory needs
entries.value: 8B 16-bit 22 GB (16 GB weights); 32B 4-bit 40 GB (18 GB); 70B 4-bit 64 GB (40 GB). KV cache 128 / 256 / 320 KB per token
entries.source: Weights at the stated precision; KV cache from the reference models' published layouts (layers × KV heads × head size × 2 × 2 bytes); data/selfhost.json

entries.label: GPU prompt-reading speed and answer streaming
entries.value: Prefill ≈ 3,800 / 2,800 / 1,100 tokens/sec (L4 8B, L40S 32B, A100 70B); 30 output tokens/sec per answer; 90% of VRAM usable
entries.source: Dense FP16 TFLOPS from NVIDIA datasheets × 50% assumed utilisation ÷ (2 × parameters); per-answer speed and usable memory are judgements. Benchmark your own model and serving engine

entries.label: Open-model quality gap
entries.value: 10 percentage points
entries.source: Judgement; varies widely by task. Applies to self-hosted and hosted open models alike. Replaced by your own test results when you enter both

entries.label: Yearly change in AI and GPU prices
entries.value: AI per-token prices −30% a year; GPU rental −15% a year
entries.source: Judgement from 2026 successor models at the same tier: Anthropic Sonnet 4.6 → 5.5 and Opus 4.6 → 5.5 cost 20–33% less, OpenAI's budget tier fell about 50%, while Google raised Gemini Flash and Pro prices for its newer models. GPU rental judged to fall more slowly. Set 0 to plan at today's prices

entries.label: Which model each provider uses per quality level
entries.value: Basic = budget model, good = mid model, best = premium model in each provider's line-up
entries.source: Role in each provider's published line-up (data/prices.json); quality is not equal across providers at the same tier, so test on your own task

entries.label: Build hours per option
entries.value: SaaS 20, API 120, self-hosted 240, hybrid 300, hosted open model 120
entries.source: Typical small-team effort

entries.label: Maintenance hours per month
entries.value: SaaS 4, API 10, self-hosted 30, hybrid 35, hosted open model 10
entries.source: Typical small-team effort

entries.label: Evaluation hours before launch
entries.value: SaaS 8, API 16, self-hosted 32, hybrid 32, hosted open model 32
entries.source: Time to build a test set and compare outputs

entries.label: Extra effort per additional workload on a stack
entries.value: 50% of the base hours
entries.source: Shared setup reused; each workload still needs its own integration and testing

entries.label: Discount rate for present value
entries.value: 10% a year
entries.source: A common hurdle rate for small businesses; use your own cost of capital

entries.label: Working hours per FTE per month
entries.value: 160 (192 in India)
entries.source: 40-hour week after holidays and leave; 48-hour week in India

entries.label: Agent completion, review and error rates
entries.value: By workflow, e.g. invoices 80% completed, 20% reviewed, 1% errors
entries.source: Judgement per workflow; measure on a pilot

entries.label: Minutes a person spends per task today
entries.value: By workflow, e.g. invoice 6, ticket 2, report 120
entries.source: Judgement per workflow; time a sample of tasks

entries.label: Staff minutes saved per request (internal tools)
entries.value: 3 minutes
entries.source: Judgement; time a sample of questions before and after

entries.label: Share of time freed that becomes money saved
entries.value: 100% (all of it)
entries.source: Judgement. Time freed becomes cash only through fewer hires, less overtime or contractors, or paid work; lower it if staff simply gain capacity

entries.label: Chat conversion, deflection and human share (industry presets)
entries.value: By industry, e.g. D2C 3% conversion, 60% deflection, 15% reach a person
entries.source: Illustrative industry defaults (data/presets.json)

entries.label: Spoken characters per minute
entries.source: About 150 words a minute of speech

entries.label: Monthly growth and how long it lasts
entries.value: 5% for 12 months
entries.source: Placeholder; use your own forecast

entries.label: Ranges for “not sure” inputs and simulations
entries.value: See METHODOLOGY 10e and 12b; AI and GPU prices drawn with correlation 0.5, their trends 0.6, engineer and staff pay 0.7
entries.source: Plausible bands chosen for illustration

entries.label: Non-cost scores, weights and profile thresholds
entries.value: 0–5 scores per option; weights 25/20/20/15/10/10; high ticket ≥ USD 10,000
entries.source: Judgement, written down with a reason per score (METHODOLOGY section 11)
